hb_halo_of_floating_shards.name: Halo of Floating Shards
hb_halo_of_floating_shards.flavor_text: The ring of shards the Exarch wore over his helm, still turning slowly when nobody's wearing it.

hb_tear_of_zin_azshari.name: Tear of Zin-Azshari
hb_tear_of_zin_azshari.flavor_text: Sea-glass with seawater sealed inside it. On a quiet night you can hear the tide.

hb_deathcharger_spurs.name: Deathcharger's Spurs
hb_deathcharger_spurs.flavor_text: Taken off the Baron's own boots. His horse never came back for them.

hb_cloak_of_the_last_crusade.name: Cloak of the Last Crusade
hb_cloak_of_the_last_crusade.flavor_text: Hale's own cloak, the flame on it stitched by his mother before Hearthglen fell.

hb_the_headmasters_register.name: The Headmaster's Register
hb_the_headmasters_register.flavor_text: Every student Gandling ever taught, and what became of them. Most of the pages end the same way.

hb_shard_of_the_wound.name: Shard of the Wound
hb_shard_of_the_wound.flavor_text: A sliver of the Heart, cooled and set in iron. It's warm against the skin all the time.

hb_dathrohans_broken_halo.name: Dathrohan's Broken Halo
hb_dathrohans_broken_halo.flavor_text: The Grand Crusader's gilded helm, cracked the night the thing inside him stopped pretending.

hb_governor_of_the_warheart.name: Governor of the Warheart
hb_governor_of_the_warheart.flavor_text: The crystal that told the Warheart how fast to burn, set in a ring by a deserter at the Dawnspear.

hb_gloomtenders_pruning_knife.name: Gloomtender's Pruning Knife
hb_gloomtenders_pruning_knife.flavor_text: Xavras cut her gardens with it. The spores on the blade still glow.

hb_caldera_cracked_gauntlets.name: Caldera-Cracked Gauntlets
hb_caldera_cracked_gauntlets.flavor_text: Dark iron that went into the Caldera's heart and came out with molten seams through it.

hb_royal_jelly_wristguards.name: Royal Jelly Wristguards
hb_royal_jelly_wristguards.flavor_text: Hide glazed with the Hive-Mother's royal jelly, which sets harder than chitin.

hb_hammer_of_the_unmade_thane.name: Hammer of the Unmade Thane
hb_hammer_of_the_unmade_thane.flavor_text: Morrun's hammer, made before he was unmade. The runes on it only light for a dwarf.

hb_unbound_felstaff.name: Unbound Felstaff
hb_unbound_felstaff.flavor_text: The staff Zar'gothrax was bound with, until he wasn't. The fel crystal still remembers him.

hb_band_of_three_tones.name: Band of Three Tones
hb_band_of_three_tones.flavor_text: Three thin bands that hum in a chord when they touch. The Cistern's water sang the same note.

hb_pitboss_gilded_pick.name: Pitboss's Gilded Pick
hb_pitboss_gilded_pick.flavor_text: Grebble never swung it once. He had people for that.

hb_tarpots_boarding_pistol.name: Tarpot's Boarding Pistol
hb_tarpots_boarding_pistol.flavor_text: Tarpot's pistol, loaded for one shot and kept that way for years.

hb_whitemanes_last_psalter.name: Whitemane's Last Psalter
hb_whitemanes_last_psalter.flavor_text: Her prayers, written in her own hand, with every name she ever raised in the margins.

hb_cowl_of_the_index.name: Cowl of the Index
hb_cowl_of_the_index.flavor_text: Stitched with the Index's catalogue in letters too small to read without a lens.

hb_unbeaten_belt.name: Belt of the Unbeaten
hb_unbeaten_belt.flavor_text: Vek'tar's champion's belt. He wore it for eleven years, and you're the reason he doesn't now.

hb_herods_red_axe.name: Herod's Red Axe
hb_herods_red_axe.flavor_text: The Scarlet Champion's axe, lacquered red so the blood wouldn't show.

hb_doans_scorched_robe.name: Doan's Scorched Robe
hb_doans_scorched_robe.flavor_text: Doan's robe, burned at the hem from the night he tried the detonation indoors.

hb_falconcrest_longbow.name: Falconcrest Longbow
hb_falconcrest_longbow.flavor_text: A Stromgarde hunting bow with falcons carved down its length.

hb_zulketh_plague_sash.name: Zul'keth's Plague Sash
hb_zulketh_plague_sash.flavor_text: Zul'keth wore it through the worst of the plague and never once caught it.

hb_razorflank_thornmail.name: Razorflank Thornmail
hb_razorflank_thornmail.flavor_text: Mail woven through with the Kraul's thorns, which still grow a little every spring.

hb_thalnos_bloodstone_mantle.name: Thalnos's Bloodstone Mantle
hb_thalnos_bloodstone_mantle.flavor_text: A red crystal at each point, grown from what Thalnos spent and never paid back.

hb_nightmare_stitched_boots.name: Nightmare-Stitched Boots
hb_nightmare_stitched_boots.flavor_text: Black hide sewn with thread that moves when you aren't looking at it.

hb_varths_gate_shield.name: Varth's Gate Shield
hb_varths_gate_shield.flavor_text: Durnholde's gate shield. Varth held the door with it for nine years.

hb_akumai_scale_leggings.name: Aku'mai Scale Leggings
hb_akumai_scale_leggings.flavor_text: Scales off the old hydra, still cold from the deep water.

hb_arugals_moonlit_wand.name: Arugal's Moonlit Wand
hb_arugals_moonlit_wand.flavor_text: Arugal called the worgen with it. It only glows under a full moon.

hb_amberglass_handwraps.name: Amberglass Handwraps
hb_amberglass_handwraps.flavor_text: Silk dipped in the tower's amber and left to set.

hb_fenris_pelt_cloak.name: Fenris Pelt Cloak
hb_fenris_pelt_cloak.flavor_text: The alpha's own pelt. The pack still follows whoever wears it, a little way.

hb_carapace_warden_bracers.name: Carapace Warden's Bracers
hb_carapace_warden_bracers.flavor_text: Plates of the Warden's shell, fitted to a wrist.

hb_mutanus_dreaming_staff.name: Mutanus's Dreaming Staff
hb_mutanus_dreaming_staff.flavor_text: A druid's staff the Devourer swallowed. It came back out greener.

hb_widowsilk_leggings.name: Widowsilk Leggings
hb_widowsilk_leggings.flavor_text: Spun from the Matriarch's own silk, which is stronger than anything a loom makes.

hb_taragamans_burning_knuckles.name: Taragaman's Burning Knuckles
hb_taragamans_burning_knuckles.flavor_text: They're still warm. They're always warm.

hb_grotto_pearl_ring.name: Grotto Pearl Ring
hb_grotto_pearl_ring.flavor_text: A black pearl the size of a thumbnail, found inside the crab. Nobody asks how it got there.
